header.description: Spell casting (FAM-09, stock): CalculateSpellCast with resist, anti-magic, elemental, level-cap, mana and area spells; CalculateResistDamage, GetSpellCastChance, CalcRoundsToOOM, CalcManaRecoveryRounds, SpellIsInGame, SpellIsUsable and the small helpers.
notes: Generated by tools/oracle/gen/spell_cast.py. The case 'table' carries the Spells rows other cases name (fields in 'fields'; Learned From and Casted By as lengths, abilities as a flat [ability, value, ...] list without empty slots) and the Classes magery fields [number, MageryType, MageryLVL], so the Rust test needs no database.
Cases 'as-*' record GetAbilityStats(n, 0) (P3-07's procedure) for the 'LVL Increases' text; the Rust test replays them.
The CalculateSpellCast profile argument sets only the fields the procedure reads (nSpellDmgBonus, nSpellcasting, nMaxMana, nSpellOverhead, nManaRegen).
